description: This file defines the 'StateMachineManager' class, which manages durable state machines within the Orleans runtime. It handles initialization, work loop processing (including log appending, snapshots, state machine registration, recovery, and deletion), and lifecycle participation. The class interacts with storage, logging, and serialization components, and includes nested types for log writing and work items.

classes.name: StateMachineManager
classes.description: Manages durable state machines, orchestrates log appending, recovery, and snapshotting, and participates in lifecycle events.

classes.name: StateMachineLogWriter
classes.description: Handles writing log entries and snapshots for a specific state machine within the manager.

classes.name: WorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for the manager's processing loop, including its type and completion source.

classes.name: StateMachineManagerState
classes.description: A wrapper around a durable dictionary for managing state machine IDs, with reset and update logic.

methods.name: RegisterStateMachine
methods.description: Registers a new durable state machine with the manager by name.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the state machine manager asynchronously, preparing it for operation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the work loop processing tasks asynchronously.

methods.name: WorkLoop
methods.description: Main asynchronous loop processing queued work items, handling recovery, log appending, snapshots, and state machine registration.

methods.name: AppendUpdatesOrSnapshotStateMachine
methods.description: Appends either entries or snapshots of a state machine to the log segment.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Enqueues and performs deletion of persistent storage, resetting state.

methods.name: RecoverAsync
methods.description: Recovers state from storage by reading log segments and applying entries to state machines.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Enqueues a write work item, performing log append or snapshot as needed.

methods.name: OnSetStateMachineId
methods.description: Assigns and updates state machine IDs, resetting state as necessary.

methods.name: TryGetStateMachine
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a registered state machine by name.
